headline: MSR markdown dents GAAP profit, distributable earnings rise
summary_short: Rithm Capital's GAAP net income fell to $56.3 million ($0.04 diluted EPS) from $102.7 million in Q1 2026, pressured by a $392.9 million MSR mark-to-market loss, while non-GAAP earnings available for distribution rose 17% to $338.9 million and the common dividend held at $0.25 per share.
summary_long: Q2 2026 GAAP net income attributable to common stockholders fell to $20.2 million ($0.04 diluted EPS) from $67.8 million ($0.12) in Q1, driven by a larger MSR fair-value loss net of hedges of $392.9 million versus $204.2 million in Q1. Revenue declined 7% q/q to $1,282.3 million on the wider MSR markdown, partly offset by asset management revenue up 34% q/q to $141 million on higher incentive fees. Non-GAAP earnings available for distribution rose to $338.9 million ($0.60/share) from $289.6 million, as Newrez pre-tax operating income (ex-MTM) grew to $307.6 million and Genesis Capital origination rose. Stockholders' equity in Rithm fell 1% q/q to $8.5 billion. Common dividend held at $0.25/share. No forward guidance given in this release.
